To open the Structurify configuration screens on Fabric, the [Mod Menu](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/modmenu) mod is required, you can [download](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/modmenu) it from [CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/modmenu).

## Step 1:
In the main minecraft menu click on the "Mods" button

<p align="center">
<img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Faboslav/structurify/refs/heads/master/.github/assets/images/wiki/setup/fabric/main_menu.webp" title="Minecraft main menu" alt="Minecraft main menu">
</p>

## Step 2:
In the mod list, find Structurify. Then click the small config button in the top-right corner.

<p align="center">
<img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Faboslav/structurify/refs/heads/master/.github/assets/images/wiki/setup/fabric/mod_menu.webp" title="Mod Menu list" alt="Mod Menu list">
</p>

## Step 3:
The Structurify configuration screen will now open. For more details about all available options, continue to the  
**[Structurify Configuration Guide](structurify-configuration-guide)**.
<p align="center">
<img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Faboslav/structurify/refs/heads/master/.github/assets/images/wiki/structures/structures_settings.webp" title="Structures settings screen" alt="Structures settings screen">
</p>
